question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Madness or obsession with males
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Andromania"** means an excessive enthusiasm or obsession with males. (पुरुषों के प्रति उन्माद)

 
 
• **Example:** Her **andromania** was evident as she constantly sought the company of men.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e.** Andromania.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Polygamy** (बहुविवाह): The practice of having more than one spouse at the same time.

 
 
• **Example:** In some cultures, polygamy is a socially accepted practice.
 
 
 
• **Loquacious** (बातूनी): Tending to talk a great deal; talkative.
 
 
• **Example:** The loquacious host kept the guests entertained throughout the evening.
 
 
 
• **Misandrist** (पुरुषद्वेषी): A person who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against men.
 
 
• **Example:** Her misandrist views made it difficult for her to form relationships with men.
 
 

40:Tc4f,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
